newsitem.title: FINLAND: VIKING TO UP CAPACITY ON ALAND ROUTES.
newsitem.headline: VIKING TO UP CAPACITY ON ALAND ROUTES.

text.p: Finnish passenger ferry operator Viking Line Ab said on Thursday it would raise capacity on routes to Aland following a decision to allow tax free sales between continental Finland and Aland from March 1997.
"Yes, we will add capacity," Viking Line marketing director Risto Peltola told Reuters.
Last week, Viking said Rosella would be replaced in summer by the bigger Isabella.
But on Thursday Peltola said Rosella will also remain in traffic between south-western Finland, Aland and Sweden.
Later when asked for more details, Viking Line CEO Nils-Erik Eklund said no decision had yet been made on where Rosella would operate.
